QuestInfo.name: Traveling Around Maple 5
QuestInfo.0: After I get done touring around Ludibrium, I should start up a conversation with Marcel
QuestInfo.1: Marcel offered to take me to El Nath. Once I get there, he advised me to look for Scadur...
QuestInfo.2: I was able to meet up with Scadur. Where will I go next?

0.0: Was Ludibrium a blast? Isn't it just a fun place to be around? Now, ready to go to the next spot?

yes.0: Alright, I'll send you to El Nath, a land covered in snow.
yes.1: Once you arrive there, talk to #eScadur#n, and he'll take you to another spot.
yes.2: Oh yes, if you step outside, you'll be encountering massive, violent wolves wandering around town, so unless you're really powerful, you won't even be able to hit them once!

no.0: Oh, you like it here, huh? Make yourself comfortable then.
no.1: After taking care of your business here, just talk to me, and I'll take you to another spot.

1.0: Welcome! Marcel told me of your arrival. Well, there's not much here besides snow, so check it out! Watch your step--it's slippery!
